lines.zh: 沼泽的水浑，正好藏身。
lines.en: Swamp water is murky, which suits hiding.

lines.zh: 我穿红树根之间的小缝。
lines.en: I thread the narrow gaps between mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 慢慢游，泥底会扬起雾。
lines.en: Slowly, or the mud bed will bloom into fog.

lines.zh: 这条水道的尽头是另一片沼泽。
lines.en: This channel ends in another stretch of swamp.

lines.zh: 水是茶色的，我靠味道认路。
lines.en: The water is tea-brown; I navigate by smell.

lines.zh: 浮萍底下凉快，我贴着走。
lines.en: Cool beneath the duckweed; I travel close to it.

lines.zh: 别嫌水脏，脏水才养鱼。
lines.en: Do not call it dirty; dirty water raises fish.

lines.zh: 我转进水草，尾巴扫了一下。
lines.en: I turn into the weeds, tail sweeping once.

lines.zh: 水深不过膝盖，够我用了。
lines.en: Knee-deep is quite enough for me.

lines.zh: 潮水退下去，我往深处挪。
lines.en: The tide is falling; I move deeper.

lines.zh: 树影一段一段，我一段一段游。
lines.en: Shadow by shadow, I swim the whole way.

lines.zh: 泥里冒泡的地方，我绕开。
lines.en: I avoid the spots where the mud bubbles.

lines.zh: 我游得不高，就在水中间。
lines.en: I swim neither high nor low, but mid-water.

lines.zh: 前面有片断木，从底下钻。
lines.en: A fallen log ahead; I go under it.

lines.zh: 我钻进水草里，等浑水沉下去。
lines.en: I slip into the weeds and wait for the mud to settle.

lines.zh: 岸边有人在洗手，我沉下去。
lines.en: Someone washes hands on the bank; I sink low.

lines.zh: 我沿着树根游，那里最阴凉。
lines.en: I follow the roots, where the shade is deepest.

lines.zh: 水变浅了，我调头往深处去。
lines.en: The water shallows, so I turn for deeper water.

lines.zh: 挂在树根边，一动不动。
lines.en: Hanging by the roots, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 沼泽安静得能听见虫叫。
lines.en: The swamp is quiet enough to hear insects.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吸水，慢慢吐水。
lines.en: Slowly draw water in, slowly let it out.

lines.zh: 水面上有蚊子，落下来吧。
lines.en: Mosquitoes above the surface. Come down.

lines.zh: 泥底的味道，说不上好。
lines.en: The taste of the mud bed is not good, exactly.

lines.zh: 红树的根须像一道帘子。
lines.en: The mangrove roots hang like a curtain.

lines.zh: 我在等水草长高一点。
lines.en: I am waiting for the weeds to grow taller.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽我熟，闭眼也认路。
lines.en: I know this swamp; I could find my way blind.

lines.zh: 潮声一来，我就知道时间。
lines.en: The tide's sound tells me the hour.

lines.zh: 我藏着，不为什么，就是喜欢。
lines.en: I hide for no reason but that I like it.

lines.zh: 水浅的地方，影子太清楚。
lines.en: In the shallows my shadow shows too clearly.

lines.zh: 一整天，我也没动几寸。
lines.en: All day, and I have moved a few inches.

lines.zh: 有片树叶落下来，正好挡我。
lines.en: A leaf fell just where I needed cover.

lines.zh: 我不叫，沼泽里叫会招祸。
lines.en: I make no sound; noise in a swamp draws trouble.

lines.zh: 你站在泥里，鞋子完了。
lines.en: You are standing in mud. Your shoes are finished.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，跟沼泽不一样。
lines.en: Your scent does not belong to this swamp.

lines.zh: 别往水里伸手，底下是泥。
lines.en: Do not reach in; the bottom is mud.

lines.zh: 我半隐在浮萍下，你看见了吗。
lines.en: Half-hidden under duckweed, did you see me?

lines.zh: 你看太久了，我先退一点。
lines.en: You have stared too long. I will back off a little.

lines.zh: 沼泽不缺我一个，你走吧。
lines.en: The swamp has enough fish without me. Go on.

lines.zh: 你的脚步把水搅成褐色。
lines.en: Your steps stir the water brown.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是抓鱼的。
lines.en: I know that look. That is a fish-catching look.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶，能装多少条。
lines.en: How many fish will that bucket of yours hold?

lines.zh: 我不动，你就看不见我。
lines.en: If I do not move, you will not see me.

lines.zh: 泥水都震了一下。
lines.en: Even the muddy water shook.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉在泥里了。
lines.en: My scales fell into the mud.

lines.zh: 疼得我钻进树根缝。
lines.en: It hurt enough to drive me into the roots.

lines.zh: 我知道是谁打的了。
lines.en: I know who hit me now.

lines.zh: 沼泽会盖住血的味道。
lines.en: The swamp will cover the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 我躲起来，别追。
lines.en: I am hiding. Do not follow.

lines.zh: 打在水里，声音很闷。
lines.en: Struck underwater, it sounded very dull.

lines.zh: 我游歪了，泥也看不清。
lines.en: I swim crooked, and the mud blurs everything.

lines.zh: 三点的生命，经不起第二下。
lines.en: Three hearts do not survive a second blow.

lines.zh: 你搅乱了整片浅水。
lines.en: You have muddied the whole shallow.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西，闻着能吃。
lines.en: Whatever sank smells edible.

lines.zh: 我不急，沼泽里抢食的都活不长。
lines.en: No hurry; in a swamp the greedy do not last.

lines.zh: 这点碎食，你放了就退开。
lines.en: Drop the scraps and then step back.

lines.zh: 我过去看一眼，只一眼。
lines.en: I will go take one look. Only one.

lines.zh: 泥里的虾比水面上的香。
lines.en: Shrimp in the mud smell better than anything above.

lines.zh: 你的手别抖，抖了我就走。
lines.en: Keep your hand steady, or I leave.

lines.zh: 我围着食物慢慢转。
lines.en: I circle the food slowly.

lines.zh: 这只是试探，我不贪。
lines.en: This is only a test. I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 吃完这口，我就回树根那里。
lines.en: One bite, then back to my roots.

lines.zh: 水里漂来的，从来不白拿。
lines.en: Nothing floats down here for free.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的水道了。
lines.en: You have stepped into my channel.

lines.zh: 一撞，泥全起来了。
lines.en: One bump, and all the mud came up.

lines.zh: 我在水下，不容易躲。
lines.en: I am underwater; dodging is not easy.

lines.zh: 别推，沼泽里推人很危险。
lines.en: Do not shove; shoving in a swamp is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我的鳞薄，你轻一点。
lines.en: My scales are thin. Be gentler.

lines.zh: 我们错开一点，各有各的路。
lines.en: Let us offset; we each have our own route.

lines.zh: 你的影子先撞上了我。
lines.en: Your shadow hit me before you did.

lines.zh: 我退到树根后面去了。
lines.en: I have withdrawn behind the roots.

lines.zh: 这一下，水草全断了。
lines.en: That knock broke the weeds clean through.

lines.zh: 泥里的鱼不该被踩。
lines.en: Fish in the mud should not be trodden on.

lines.zh: 沼泽这么大，找到你真好。
lines.en: The swamp is vast; finding you is good.

lines.zh: 我们挑一处水草厚的地方。
lines.en: Let us choose a place where the weed grows thick.

lines.zh: 你的花纹比我的淡。
lines.en: Your pattern is fainter than mine.

lines.zh: 红树根下面没人来。
lines.en: No one comes under the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 潮水涨之前，我们要定下来。
lines.en: Before the tide rises, we should settle.

lines.zh: 同类在这片水里越来越少了。
lines.en: Our kind grows scarcer in this water.

lines.zh: 一起躲在这片阴影里。
lines.en: Let us hide together in this shade.

lines.zh: 你游前面，我跟着。
lines.en: Swim ahead; I will follow.

lines.zh: 泥底软，适合留下后代。
lines.en: The mud bed is soft, good for leaving young.

lines.zh: 从今往后，这片水有两尾丝足鲈。
lines.en: From now, this water holds two gourami.

lines.zh: 这片叶子沉底了，我收了。
lines.en: A leaf has sunk; I will take it.

lines.zh: 水底有颗果子，烂了一半。
lines.en: A fruit on the bottom, half rotted.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西，我先踩一脚。
lines.en: I give sunken things a nudge first.

lines.zh: 这块碎木能当遮蔽。
lines.en: This splinter of wood will do for cover.

lines.zh: 捡东西要快，沼泽里眼多。
lines.en: Pick things up fast; many eyes watch in a swamp.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进泥里藏好。
lines.en: I push it into the mud to hide it.

lines.zh: 你们掉的东西，都到了这里。
lines.en: Everything you drop ends up down here.

lines.zh: 这块太硬，我啃不动。
lines.en: This one is too hard for me to chew.

lines.zh: 泥里的食物，得先用尾巴扫净。
lines.en: Food in the mud needs a sweep of the tail first.

lines.zh: 别丢东西进沼泽，没人来捞。
lines.en: Stop dropping things in the swamp; nobody fishes them out.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，是从上面来的。
lines.en: There is blood in the water, and it came from above.

lines.zh: 那片水草在抖，不是水在动。
lines.en: That weed is trembling, and not from the water.

lines.zh: 泥里有一只虾，尾巴还在弹。
lines.en: A shrimp in the mud, tail still flicking.

lines.zh: 我盯上了浮在水面的小虫。
lines.en: I have set my eye on a bug on the surface.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼拐进了我的水道。
lines.en: The big fish has turned into my channel.

lines.zh: 前面那片浮萍有东西在动。
lines.en: Something is moving in the duckweed ahead.

lines.zh: 我锁定的东西，通常都吃不到。
lines.en: What I fix on usually escapes me.

lines.zh: 泥水一浑，谁也看不见谁。
lines.en: Once the mud rises, no one sees anyone.

lines.zh: 有影子压过来，很大。
lines.en: A shadow is bearing down. A large one.

lines.zh: 食物和危险，常常一起出现。
lines.en: Food and danger usually arrive together.

lines.zh: 它在找我，我藏在树根里。
lines.en: It is hunting me; I hide in the roots.

lines.zh: 我往浑水里钻，越浑越好。
lines.en: Into the muddiest water. The muddier the better.

lines.zh: 它追进来了，水道太窄。
lines.en: It followed in, and the channel is too narrow.

lines.zh: 我顺着泥底滑，不搅水。
lines.en: I slide along the bed without stirring it.

lines.zh: 心跳很响，沼泽把它放大了。
lines.en: My heartbeat is loud, and the swamp amplifies it.

lines.zh: 前面有断木，我钻底下。
lines.en: A fallen log ahead; I go beneath it.

lines.zh: 它张嘴了，牙齿很白。
lines.en: It opened its mouth. Very white teeth.

lines.zh: 我只有三下力气，得算着用。
lines.en: I have three bursts of strength; I must ration them.

lines.zh: 这片水草太疏，挡不住它。
lines.en: This weed is too sparse to stop it.

lines.zh: 我停住不动，让它游过去。
lines.en: I hold still and let it swim past.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，像啃水草。
lines.en: I bit you like nibbling weed.

lines.zh: 这条鱼不会打架，只会躲。
lines.en: This fish does not fight; it only hides.

lines.zh: 我撞你，是想让你走开。
lines.en: I bumped you because I want you gone.

lines.zh: 力气都用在逃跑上了。
lines.en: All my strength goes into running.

lines.zh: 别怕，我的嘴只有豆子大。
lines.en: Do not fear; my mouth is the size of a bean.

lines.zh: 我咬的是你的影子。
lines.en: It was your shadow I bit.

lines.zh: 这一口是护着水草。
lines.en: That bite was to guard the weed.

lines.zh: 我连浮萍都咬不穿。
lines.en: I cannot even bite through duckweed.

lines.zh: 攻击完了，我该沉底了。
lines.en: Attack finished. Time to sink to the bottom.

lines.zh: 别把我当成凶的鱼。
lines.en: Do not take me for a fierce fish.

lines.zh: 浑水一入口，我就安心了。
lines.en: One mouthful of murk and I feel at home.

lines.zh: 我从红树的根缝里出来。
lines.en: I come out from a gap in the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽没有主人，我来当。
lines.en: This swamp has no owner. I will be one.

lines.zh: 水是温的，泥是软的，正好。
lines.en: Warm water, soft mud. Just right.

lines.zh: 浮萍遮住我，像一块布。
lines.en: The duckweed covers me like a cloth.

lines.zh: 我听见虫鸣，就知道来对了。
lines.en: I hear insects, so I came to the right place.

lines.zh: 浅水、树根、烂叶，都齐了。
lines.en: Shallows, roots, rotting leaves. All present.

lines.zh: 先找地方藏，再想别的。
lines.en: First find cover; think of the rest later.

lines.zh: 沼泽的鱼都低调。
lines.en: Swamp fish keep a low profile.

lines.zh: 我落进水里，没溅起什么。
lines.en: I entered the water with barely a splash.

lines.zh: 水面起火，我往泥里钻。
lines.en: The surface is on fire; I burrow into the mud.

lines.zh: 被拎起来又掉回沼泽。
lines.en: Lifted up, then dropped back into the swamp.

lines.zh: 我在沼泽里喘不上气。
lines.en: In the swamp, and I cannot get air.

lines.zh: 泥和水一起炸上天。
lines.en: Mud and water blew skyward together.

lines.zh: 箭头扎进泥里，离我很近。
lines.en: An arrowhead struck the mud very near me.

lines.zh: 沼泽突然安静，不对劲。
lines.en: The swamp went suddenly silent. Something is wrong.

lines.zh: 沼泽里全是吃的，我找不到。
lines.en: There is food all around this swamp; I cannot find it.

lines.zh: 雷打在红树上，水都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hit a mangrove; the water lit up.

lines.zh: 沼泽被抽干，我悬在空里。
lines.en: The swamp drained away and I hang in nothing.
